Aircraft Systems

نظام الإنذار بقرب الأرض

An aircraft safety system that warns pilots if the aircraft is at risk of controlled flight into terrain or obstacles.

Quick answer: An aircraft safety system that warns pilots if the aircraft is at risk of controlled flight into terrain or obstacles.
